conclusion: Supported in part: the MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the requirement for transparent, orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular contaminants, and appropriate controls (thus supporting the need for an orthogonal QC panel, validated intact-EV assays, and robust production reporting before advancing formulation/bridging). The guidance does NOT contain program-specific manufacturing, assay validation, stability, or cross-species biodistribution data, so any assertions that SGL-001 currently lacks or does demonstrate those program-specific records cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.
unsupported_assertions: Assertion that current SGL-001 materials definitively do not demonstrate characterized Master Cell Bank (MCB) / Working Cell Bank (WCB) generation and characterization — MISEV2023 is guidance and contains no program-specific MCB/WCB records to verify this.

Assertion that validated intact-EV assays (with documented LLOQ, specificity, precision) for SGL-001 are absent — the supplied evidence contains no assay validation reports to support or refute this program-level claim.
Assertion that stability-indicating potency assays linked to an in vivo PD endpoint have not been developed for SGL-001 — MISEV2023 does not provide program-specific potency assay data.
Assertion that reproducible release/stability/potency across ≥3 GMP-like SGL-001 batches is lacking — no batch comparability or GMP-like run data are present in the supplied evidence to confirm this.

Strong claim that rodent intranasal biodistribution data alone are insufficient to predict reproducible intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species — MISEV2023 recommends rigorous controls and orthogonal analytics but does not provide empirical cross-species PK/PD data to quantitatively verify translatability for this program.
